Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the foundry name by extracting "Cold Spring Foundry" from the search results, whereas the correct name is "West Point Foundry." The search results explicitly stated "The West Point Foundry was a major American ironworking... site in Cold Spring, New York." The Planner incorrectly assumed the location name (Cold Spring) was the primary part of the entity's name, failing to recognize that the foundry was named after its proximity to West Point (the military academy across the river), not the village it was physically located in. This is a classic case of misinterpreting search result metadata where the location is conflated with the entity name.
